bias.label: Bounce testing 3,635-3,650; still leaning down below 3,650

event: Mon 23 Nov 16:45 SAST: US flash PMI and Fed speakers. Wed 25 Nov 15:30 SAST: US core PCE, GDP, durable goods, jobless claims (FOMC minutes also due Wed, time UNVERIFIED). Thu 26 Nov: US Thanksgiving, thin trade. Fed decision 9 Dec.

bullets.title: Bounce extends
bullets.text: Spot gold was near 3,612 at 10:49 SAST, up about 2.8% on the day, after touching about 3,635-3,641 earlier this morning.

bullets.title: First ceiling tested
bullets.text: The high so far sits right inside the 3,630-3,650 zone, so this is where buyers and sellers will be tested.

bullets.title: Hike bets easing
bullets.text: CME FedWatch shows about a 93% chance of a quarter-point hike on 9 December, down from 99% on Friday, which is helping gold.

bullets.title: Dollar slightly softer
bullets.text: The dollar index was near 103.66, down about 0.14%, and yields slipped back under 5% (exact 10-year level today UNVERIFIED).

bullets.title: Trend still down
bullets.text: Gold lost about 9% last week and touched about 3,504, so one strong day has not changed the bigger downtrend yet.

bullets.title: Data-heavy week
bullets.text: Flash PMI is tonight at 16:45 SAST, and PCE and GDP land Wednesday at 15:30 SAST before the US holiday.

levels.note: Last week's low near 3,503; 16 Nov high 3,506; round 3,500
